about: Game plans for the strategist AI (src/ai/strategist). Add a strategy by adding an entry; docs/ai.md explains every field. 'when' lists conditions that must all hold ('!' negates; 'canBuild:<unit id|category|tag|moveClass|role|attribute>' with '|' for any of several). 'build' multiplies how much the AI wants a unit type: by unit id, category, moveClass, tag, role (capture, carrier, healer, supplier, layer, radar, indirect, combat), attribute, or fast (move 6+), heavy (cost 10000+), cheap (cost 3000 or less). 'tactics.target' is what the army marches on: army, hq, properties or balanced; aggression and caution scale attacking and avoiding danger; capture scales the wish to capture; mass holds the army back until it has that many fighting units; landing scales carrier landings; retreat scales the HP at which units go home for repairs.

strategies.name: Combined arms
strategies.summary: A bit of everything, sent where it hurts most.

strategies.name: Tank assault
strategies.summary: Mass tracked armour and roll over the front.

strategies.name: Heavy armour
strategies.summary: Few, expensive, hard to kill units that grind forward.

strategies.name: Blitz
strategies.summary: Fast units straight at the enemy HQ before they are ready.

strategies.name: HQ rush
strategies.summary: Everything goes for the enemy HQ, capturers first.

strategies.name: Artillery siege
strategies.summary: A wall of guns behind a screen, shelling anything that comes close.

strategies.name: Turtle and counter
strategies.summary: Dig in, build up, then strike with a big army.

strategies.name: Attrition
strategies.summary: Keep units alive: medics, supply and pulling back to repair.

strategies.name: Land grab
strategies.summary: Out-earn the enemy: capture everything first, fight later.

strategies.name: Mechanized infantry
strategies.summary: Infantry in numbers, with carriers to move them.

strategies.name: Air rush
strategies.summary: Own the sky and strike from it.

strategies.name: Air cavalry
strategies.summary: Helicopters and troop drops behind the lines.

strategies.name: Flak screen
strategies.summary: Answer an air force with anti-air and fighters.

strategies.name: Naval supremacy
strategies.summary: Win the sea, then shell the coast.

strategies.name: Island hopping
strategies.summary: Carry troops across the water and take the islands one by one.

strategies.name: Amphibious assault
strategies.summary: Units that swim and drive come out of the sea where they are least expected.

strategies.name: Coastal bombardment
strategies.summary: Across the water, ships and planes wear the enemy down before anyone lands.

strategies.name: Stealth raid
strategies.summary: Cloaked units hit what the enemy cannot see coming.
